scholarly_attribution.author: Raquel Martín Hernández
scholarly_attribution.institutional_rank: Original ranked source remains Harvard Center for Hellenic Studies
scholarly_attribution.date_policy: Preserve citation-year and URL-date separately, without silently correcting either.
scholarly_attribution.scope: Primary scholarly research account of historical witnesses; not a complete modern executable oracle table

historical_findings.fact: Three witnesses: P.Lond.121 (=PGM VII),P.Oxy.56.3831,P.Bon.3 (=Suppl.Mag.II.77). Source dates P.Bon. to2nd–3rd centuries,P.Oxy. to3rd–4th and PGM VII near late4th; note25 records differing scholarly dates. Not three interchangeable complete editions.

P.Oxy. text stops after source keyαγς(1,3,6); numbers continue throughαεα(1,5,1) without corresponding verses. Those are three die-face digits, not decimal ordinal136 or151. Missing verse text is not an adverse answer.

PGM VII nearly complete; other copies help damaged beginning. Author argues common verse order in overlap and no evidence for alternate full versions; this is not authority to invent missing entries or ignore later corrections. Article does not provide all216 mappings.

One six-sided die thrown three times; ordered faces1..6; keys111 through666 in lexicographic order. Preserve temporal order, not sorted triple or sum. Numbers2 and5 rule out ordinary four-position knucklebone substitution.

Historical instructions include day/hour table and Apollo prayer, plus question focus. Descriptive context only; no implemented ritual schedule, invocation requirement or supernatural certification. No fixed question list.
A selected Homeric verse is contextualized as an answer historically. That interpretation is distinct from book/line identity, calculated selection and present-day factual prediction.
Socrates dream narrative cites Iliad9.363; useful literary-context cross-reference, not a documented die-roll-to-table fixture.

numerical_audit.homeric_domain: 216 ordered triples in{1,...,6}^3; 111 and666 are face labels, not integer range111..666
numerical_audit.proposed_editorial_ordinal: If frozen later: one-based i=36*(a-1)+6*(b-1)+c. An editorial storage map derived from source order, not an ancient decimal numbering claim.
numerical_audit.distribution: Uniform1/216 per triple only conditional on three independent fair six-face draws; audit supplies no RNG, entropy model or empirical fairness claim. Sorting gives56 distinct multisets with unequal weights and loses source order; sums give16 values3..18. Neither is the Homeric keyed table.
numerical_audit.complete_outcome_table: Not frozen: require independently collated exact216 keys with source locus/text/uncertain/lacuna status and explicit source edition. No verse mappings inferred from Wikipedia or another app.

mascaro_findings.fact: Simple practice chooses a book/page and first noticed sentence; integer method chooses discrete levels. A personal metaphysical account is source attribution, not empirical evidence.

mascaro_findings.locator: The first step; The next step
mascaro_findings.fact: Reachable shelves numbered top to bottom starting1; books left to right starting1. Coarse method returns a sentence; fine method assembles individual words.

mascaro_findings.locator: Upon selecting; Next; In the fine method
mascaro_findings.fact: Select book,page,sentence and optionally word. Digital alternative requests bounded integer1..N. Invalid page causes reroll; shelf invalid face rerolls. Sentence/word/zero-page, blank page, multi-column order, headings, end-page sentence continuation and exact tokenization are not fully specified.

mascaro_findings.locator: If you are enacting a fine divination
mascaro_findings.fact: Source offers sum of two0–9 dice for desired word count or digital integer1..20. Dice sum actually ranges0..18 with triangular multiplicities; digital proposal ranges1..20. This is a source discrepancy, not equivalent distributions.

mascaro_findings.locator: You will now use your ten-sided die
mascaro_findings.fact: Seventeen-book example restricts ones to0..7 and maps tens to0/1. Literal candidate set00..07,10..17 omits08,09 and includes invalid00. Order of rolling digit places also varies in the paragraph. Do not silently implement this as uniform selection1..17.

Page digit-place proposals and reroll invalids are described, but no named digital PRNG/seed/rejection protocol, page label mapping or exact edition. Unbiased whole-number rejection could be a separately named software convention after independent specification.
Fine method repeats the whole shelf-to-word path per requested word, then allows readability edits. Preserve original chosen tokens and user edits separately; not automatic source wording.

Author prefers digital bounded integers. No full numeric worked chain or exact selected-book edition is supplied. Independent synthetic numerical fixtures will need clear labels and must not be advertised as published worked examples.

rights.ancient: Ancient Homeric originals are distinct from modern translations, apparatus, editorial reconstruction, digital transcriptions and scans; verify each layer independently.
rights.chs: General online-publications policy says CC BY-NC-ND3.0 unless otherwise stated. Item/third-party scope remains to be checked before reuse; only factual notes distributed here.
rights.llewellyn: Retains copyright. Free website full-article posting permission has conditions and excludes general publication/sale; Future uses concise procedural facts and citations only.

staged_contract: Immutable ordered shelf/book catalog and exact edition identity; single-book mode explicitly a bounded adaptation.
Raw source bytes hash plus canonical corpus/index hash; fixed encoding, Unicode/normalization/newline policy and immutable unit IDs.
Logical page/printed page labels and sentence boundary maps are explicit; do not manufacture print pagination for unpaginated HTML.

Manual one-based selections checked at every level; invalid/empty units return explicit diagnostic, no automatic reroll or silently skipped pages. This is a proposed software policy, not a source quotation.
Replay includes exact selected path, corpus/profile/request hashes, precise cited passage and surrounding context, user question/notes and raw interpretation separately.
No autogenerated predictions. External/manual draws have no software probability certification. Seeded mode deferred until independent protocol/distribution proof.
first_candidate.distribution: Hierarchical uniform shelf/book/page/sentence draws do not give uniform sentences over unequal groups; probability is product of reciprocals of each conditional group size. Fine repeats are with possible re-selection unless a separate protocol says otherwise. Do not conflate with uniform flattened passage sampling.

independent_fixture_plan: Before implementation freeze concise source procedures and an independently hand-indexed complete bounded corpus map. Include source-byte and canonical hashes.

Unicode, whitespace, quoted punctuation, abbreviation and page-crossing sentence cases with predetermined outcomes; display line-wrap changes must not change stable units.
Exact JSON/Markdown replay from frozen corpus/profile/request; unknown corpus/hash/version rejected. New edition must have a new profile/hash.
